content.text: 22hDavid Cartlidge, James DielhennTyson Fury, above, is the lineal and WBC heavyweight champion of the world. Mikey Williams/Top Rank Inc via Getty ImagesESPNJan 28, 2026, 12:16 PM ETReactionsTyson Fury, of Manchester, England, is the former lineal and WBC heavyweight champion of the world. Fury has fought in two different trilogies -- he beat Derek Chisora all three fights (2 KOs and a unanimous decision) and is 2-0-1 with 2 KOs against Deontay Wilder (with a split draw in the first fight).
